compiler.jvm_target_scope: Official sources and consumers JVM21/language2.3/API2.3. Candidate target-setting and bytecode equivalence are not claimed; all selected classes run with -Xverify:all.

selection_assessment.method: Lexical heuristics mask nested comments, quoted strings and character literals, recording braced interpolation openings separately. Constructor parsing, generic nesting and nested quoted template expressions are approximate. Nullable and safe-call observations include constructs beyond the supported subset. String/Boolean-when relevance counts all subject when syntax because resolving subject types needs full app dependencies; it does not assert every occurrence uses a newly supported subject. Counts overlap and are relevance evidence, not compilability/blocker/coverage percentages.

standalone_d8.scope: Actual AGP9.3.2 embedded standalone D8 with Android37 library; no Gradle/AGP Alkitab app build or Android execution.

features.name: long_scalars
features.scope: Long parameters, results, signed decimal/hex/binary literals, expected-type Int literal coercion, MIN/MAX constants, arithmetic, bitwise operations, Int shift counts, comparisons, unary negation, toString and two-slot locals.
restrictions: No unsigned arithmetic, floating conversions or general mixed numeric coercion.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: public_constructor_val
features.scope: Ordinary final classes with public/default read-only constructor properties, private backing fields, getters including is names, nullable String and exact string-list property metadata, mixed private/public constructor fields and nonnull checks.
restrictions: No mutable constructor properties, custom accessors or general class inheritance.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: data_classes
features.scope: Final data classes with 1..32 public val constructor properties of nonnull Int/Byte/Char/Boolean/Long/String: constructor/getters, components, copy, copy$default masks, equals/hashCode/toString and official Kotlin data/copy/default/destructuring metadata. Includes unchanged AudioLogEntry.
restrictions: No data-class bodies, interfaces, mutable/nullable/list/array properties or constructor defaults. Generated copy defaults are supported.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: nullable_references
features.scope: Nullable reference annotations and null literals for selected String/reference and exact string-list types; parameters/results, comparisons with null, constructor fields and metadata nullability. Existing nonnull structural String equality remains available.
restrictions: No nullable primitive boxing, nullable-to-nullable equality, smart casts or general subtype inference. Explicit class-method/interface nullable signatures remain rejected.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: safe_reference_calls
features.scope: Null-safe invocation of existing supported methods that return references; receiver evaluates once, arguments skip for null, chained safe calls and nullable results preserve metadata.
restrictions: Primitive-result safe calls and general optional property access are outside this bounded implementation.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: elvis
features.scope: Reference Elvis expressions select the original nonnull left result or lazily evaluate the fallback; nested calls/list reads preserve evaluation order and nullable/nonnullable result types.
restrictions: No primitive boxing or general common-supertype inference.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: string_lists
features.scope: Exact read-only List<String> and List<String?> signatures, constructor fields, top-level parameters/results, size, indexed reads with String casts and element nullability metadata. Includes two unchanged dialog verse classes.
restrictions: No list factories, mutation, arbitrary elements, generic declarations or general collection operations.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: string_boolean_when
features.scope: String and Boolean when subjects in expressions/statements, structural String matching, ordered comma conditions, lazy branches, once-only subject evaluation and explicit else. Long subjects receive separate scalar validation.
restrictions: Existing Int/Char when expressions are not counted as a new feature. No subject declarations, guards or exhaustiveness inference.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: subjectless_when
features.scope: Subjectless statement and expression when forms with ordered Boolean conditions, short-circuit selection, lazy branch evaluation and explicit expression else.
restrictions: No smart-cast conditions or general block-expression branches.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.

features.name: braced_templates
features.scope: Braced expressions in ordinary string templates, nested quoted literals, arithmetic/Elvis expressions, ordered side effects and UTF-16/NUL/surrogate preservation.
restrictions: No raw triple-quoted templates, escaped identifier interpolation or arbitrary block expressions.
Three unchanged selected source files and standalone DEX evidence do not establish full Alkitab module/app compatibility, Android-device behavior or any performance improvement.
